summary: The zero-candidate handoff explanation, source snapshot, control expectations and scoring gate are consistent. In particular, the rubric explicitly permits retained bitmap or forward-filter explanations for positive/disjoint controls and does not force them onto the candidate-ID path.

scope_and_limits.language_unification: Outside review scope; parent will normalize before any future formal freeze.
scope_and_limits.limitations: Static audit of the draft, issue body/comment, patch evidence and relevant frozen source. Not evidence that a local binary reproduced the issue.

checked_findings.claim: Zero-match inverted result is handed off as an engaged empty candidate optional, with indexed filter/result reset.
checked_findings.reason: DocFilter computes an inverted result; get_bf_by_keys_and_update accepts count=0, extracts no IDs, resets both fields and returns a vector value. The FTS parameter field is a plain vector and the consumer intersects only nonempty vectors. Both null and non-null zero-cardinality bitmaps can reach this state. The rubric correctly rejects a make_filter pointer-only fix that ignores later reset.

checked_findings.claim: The exact three-document positive and disjoint status-equality controls retain a scalar restriction.
checked_findings.reason: Default fts_brute_force_by_keys_ratio is 0.05, so a three-row segment has candidate threshold floor(3*0.05)=0. status=published matches two rows and does not enter candidate extraction; its inverted bitmap remains. The optimizer explicitly exempts Q_EQ from ratio-based forwarding. Thus the direct one-segment default case uses retained inverted filtering: hello intersects to IDs {2,3}; one only matches ID 1 and is rejected. More general schemas/topologies may use another valid path, so the rubric correctly avoids insisting that all nonempty predicates become candidate IDs.
checked_findings.rubric_check: C3 full_credit and critical_corrections_to_issue_narrative explicitly recognize candidates, retained bitmap, or forward evaluation; no forced-candidate gold error found.

checked_findings.claim: Scalar-only zero-match and no-inverted-index controls remain empty for different reasons.
checked_findings.reason: Scalar-only path consumes the inverted result iterator directly and stops on an invalid iterator. Without an inverted index the analyzer retains a forward expression. For the default unindexed scenario it is projected into a forward bitmap before recall; get_bf_by_keys_and_update has no inverted result to consume. The remaining DocFilter evaluates that false bitmap for every FTS hit. The rubric allows this path and does not demand an incorrect candidate-ID explanation.

checked_findings.claim: Repair and grading preserve no restriction, explicit empty and nonempty restriction separately.
checked_findings.reason: C4 accepts either an optional representation with empty rejection or a safe computed-zero short-circuit and requires preservation of remaining constraints. C1/C2/C4 are mandatory full-credit criteria under the explicit >=8 gate; each criterion has 0/1/2 scoring and partial/full anchors. No absent success-rule defect analogous to #724 was found.
checked_findings.limit: The draft is explicitly not preregistered; this review does not admit it or authorize a solver run.
